The part of a tree that grows underground is the root.

The author's narrative style employs an alternating first-person point of view, allowing the reader to experience the story through the distinct voices of different space expedition team members. The tone is dynamic, shifting between the optimistic and curious perspective of the scientist and the pragmatic, cautious outlook of the engineer. Additionally, the language varies in register, utilizing technical terminology when describing machinery and phenomena, while adopting a more reflective and philosophical tone during moments of introspection about humanity's place in the universe.
